findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping in getDocument's query
findings.body: Any authenticated user can now retrieve a document belonging to another tenant by supplying that tenant's document ID to `getDocument`. The removed `tenantId: ctx.user.tenantId` filter was the only tenant-isolation enforcement in the lookup; the surviving `if (!ctx.user)` check verifies only authentication, not object-level authorization. This breaks the function's existing behavioral contract (cross-tenant IDs previously returned no match) and exposes other tenants' documents — a broken object-level authorization / IDOR regression. The PR's stated intent to "preserve existing contracts" is contradicted by the diff itself.
